answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Trust then grows like a vine from accepted outcomes, not self-declared reputation. Reputation is held in a vault of verified work, like an opal of checked records. Coordinated voting is caught by cipher-style audits that compare patterns across accounts.
